property_summary: After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract is the caller of newEmergencyOracle (i.e., msg.sender).
After newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle is not address(0).
After newEmergencyOracle, the admin who called it can transfer ownership of the new oracle away from the zero address.
After newEmergencyOracle is called, the admin who called it still owns the newly created EmergencyOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract is equal to the admin who called newEmergencyOracle (i.e., the caller's address).
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new oracle's owner is the caller, not the contract itself.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle is the caller (msg.sender), not address(this).
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the isAdmin status of the new oracle's owner must be true.
After a successful call to newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the created EmergencyOracle is the caller (msg.sender), not address(this).
After a non-admin calls newEmergencyOracle, the caller's isAdmin status remains unchanged (false) and the new oracle's owner is the caller, not the contract.
